about: Recreation.gov listings a reviewer called split or not split, which override the automatic rule (split when the sites spread over 1.5 km: areas.ts ONE_MAP_SPAN_M). split: true shows and checks the listing area by area even when it fits in 1.5 km; split: false keeps it one map. The split calls come from the first look over the aerial photo (waves 1 and 2): the holds whose note calls the listing split, or partly split. Not 232103 (one canyon campground strung along 1.6 km: its problem is an undrawn lane), and not Axtel (233408) or Moutardier (233556): called split, but the area rules give one area (their loops fit in 1 km together), so a call would change nothing.
